name: ai-ready
description: Audit codebases for AI-readiness using a 7-category 100-point rubric, then apply ROI-prioritized improvements (CLAUDE.md scaffolds, ANTIPATTERNS.md seeds, INDEX.md, ARCHITECTURE.md Mermaid diagrams, freshness Stop hook, trend sparkline). Multi-module and single-module (package-as-module) layouts are scored on parallel rubrics. v0.2.0+: optional .ai-ready/config.json drives frontmatter-aware INDEX grouping and preserves user-edited lazy-load triggers. v0.3.0+: the config.json rubric section makes scoring respect project reality — a consolidated decision dir (docs/design) counts as ADR, code-gen deps (springdoc) count as API contracts, and project-level .claude/settings.json lint/test hooks count as a verification gate. v0.4.0+: apply guards human-adopted docs — generators refuse to overwrite a file that lacks the auto-generated signature (--force to override), and apply runs a per-doc diff-confirm loop instead of blind overwrite. v0.4.2+: INDEX generation respects .gitignore — inside a git repo only tracked or unignored .md files are indexed, so generated artifacts (http API docs) and local-only files (.claude/commands) no longer pollute INDEX; non-git directories fall back to the full walk. v0.5.0+: apply maintains docs surgically — the doc-touching scripts (gen_index, gen_arch_diagram, extract_section, inject_module_map, inject_lazy_load_index) gain a --json facts-only mode (read-only), and the AI adds new entries and updates changed ones while preserving human curation (groups, ordering, prose) instead of mechanically overwriting whole docs. v0.6.0+: the loop-engine is folded in as part of this single plugin — the autonomous maker→checker→deterministic-rubric verification loop (skills /loop-run, /loop-review, /loop-lessons + agents loop-checker, loop-lesson-synthesizer + the _loop-engine scoring shell) ships alongside audit/apply, so installing ai-ready brings the whole audit→apply→verify cycle. The loop reads the docs/ANTIPATTERNS.md that ai-ready writes as its knowledge layer and appends caught mistakes back to it (same AI-additive append, no wholesale overwrite). Build/test/lint commands, ticket pattern and base branch are runtime-detected (detect_build.py), so no adapter file is persisted; only an optional project-local .loop/rubric.md is merged over the engine BASE rubric. v0.8.0+: the loop-build skill adds multi-phase autonomous build-out — it wraps loop-run's checker+rubric verdict engine in an outer phase loop where the maker is a per-phase subagent (continued via SendMessage within a phase, fresh per phase) so many phases build out unattended while the orchestrator stays coding-free; commits are deferred to wrapup. v0.8.1+: loop-build fail-loud-validates phases.json before the unattended traversal — a jq assertion rejects a malformed decomposition (empty/non-array .phases, missing name/steps/ac_cmd, or an out-of-enum status) with exit 65 so a corrupt spec halts for a human instead of silently mis-traversing. v0.8.2+: the loop skills (loop-run/loop-build/loop-review) and the loop-checker agent recover findings via a deterministic output file the orchestrator names in the checker prompt, not by scraping the checker's final chat message — a background/unattended session never delivers a subagent's final text inline, so file recovery is the only mode-agnostic path. loop-checker's no-write Bash rule gains one narrow carve-out (write only that single findings JSON path, nothing else; refuse if it points at a source file), the orchestrator clears the file before each spin so a stale prior-cycle result can't masquerade as a pass, and a fail-loud [ -s ] guard rejects an empty/missing findings file instead of silently passing. v0.8.3+: wiring & context-hygiene batch — the freshness Stop hook is self-contained (the copied .sh locates freshness_check.py next to itself and audit copies the .py too, so a project-context hook no longer dies on unset CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT); convention-docs/knowledge-layer/LOCAL-rubric paths are passed to the checker and lesson-synthesizer IN THE PROMPT (env vars never reach subagents, so the old wiring silently degraded every checker to the no-convention-docs path); loop-run persists brake values and detected commands to a params.env re-derived at the top of every step (a fresh shell per Bash call was silently disarming the iteration/time brake) and counts gate-failure re-entries against the brake; loop-build scopes stall state and the gate counter per phase and enforces the per-phase history split by re-pointing params.env (a prior phase's floor no longer manufactures false STALLED verdicts); the re-derivation pointer is per-branch (.active-{branch}) so an interleaved second loop cannot hijack a paused loop's state, params.env is sourced with set -a so LOCAL-rubric env reaches the scoring child processes, and the gate-failure counter increments self-contained from its file and codifies orchestrator context hygiene (never read findings/evidence prose inline — score summaries only, hand the maker the scored-file path instead of pasting findings, update phases.json via jq not Read/Edit, and prefer starting loop-build in a fresh session after design); decide/stall fail-loud-validate their input contracts; npm's default test stub is not adopted as a gate; loop-review detects the base branch before diffing and isolates its findings file per branch; the BASE rubric's security narrowing to IDOR-only is re-labeled as a c8c-api LOCAL decision (BASE stays broad).
